77b9cb93d8.q: What is the difference between AI-powered and AI-distracted approaches in veterinary business management?
77b9cb93d8.a: AI-powered means using AI to remove friction points and reduce effort on grunt work while preserving human decision-making and personality. AI-distracted means building cool tools that look impressive but do not actually save time or improve outcomes. The difference lies in applying the filter: does this make the business better, faster, or easier? If not, it is distraction.

92a7cc15e0.q: How should veterinary practice owners approach data security when connecting business information to AI systems like Claude or ChatGPT?
92a7cc15e0.a: Use silos where information is stored in secure locations like Dropbox and only connected to AI when explicitly configured. For paid accounts on ChatGPT or Claude, data is secure by default and does not train on user data or expose it to the internet. Companies like OpenAI and Anthropic see the data but are legally bound as stewards; they cannot sell or leak it without severe legal consequences, similar to how EasyVet and RxWorks handle veterinary data.

d0d53cbe48.q: What shift in thinking about AI adoption has most accelerated Sam Bowden's understanding over the past six months?
d0d53cbe48.a: The biggest shift was realizing that by connecting AI to everything in the business—linking it to accounting, Zoom calls, consulting sessions, and business data—AI becomes like the heartbeat and brain of the business, knowing detailed patterns that humans miss. The second shift was understanding that asking AI what it is seeing in the data, rather than directing it to perform specific tasks, unlocks exponentially more opportunities.
